result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: the fixed bottom navigation obscures feed content, and the promotional banner has poor text contrast.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar overlays the next restaurant card in the “Popular right now” feed. The card image/content is visibly cut off behind the navigation, with no bottom spacing to keep it fully visible.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content (at least the navigation bar height plus safe-area inset) so the final visible cards scroll fully above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The white promotional text on the pale mint banner has very low contrast, especially the smaller line “Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10,” making it difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color or darken the banner background/overlay to meet readable contrast levels.

issues.description: The horizontal category row and restaurant carousel show partially clipped items at the right edge, which can look like unintended overflow because there is no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible carousel cue, such as consistent partial-card peeking with padding, a fade/gradient edge, or an explicit horizontal-scroll indicator.
